meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill for omo-senpi. Self-orchestrates a 5-member hostile team (categories unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via the native lead team tools for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the insights that survive the attacks, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled bundle to a planner task (load_skills ulw-plan) for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用对抗式辩论打磨规划方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果您的规划需要暴露隐藏的弱点并提升严谨性
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your planning needs rigorous critique to surface hidden flaws

howto.what: 你说出触发词后,Claude 会宣布 'HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED!',开启'敌意规划'模式:它扮演领队,召集 5 个立场各异的虚拟成员互相挑刺,只留下扛得住批评的要点,最后交给专门的规划环节整理成可执行计划。
howto.when: 当你说出'hyperplan'、'hpp'、'adversarial plan' 等触发词,或提出需要严格检验假设、暴露盲点的规划需求时,该技能会接管。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 模式帮我规划这个功能。
say.note: Claude 会启动 5 人敌意团队交叉评审。

say.text: 启动 adversarial plan,狠批我的方案。
say.note: 成员会互相攻击,只保留经得起质疑的部分。

say.text: 开启 hostile planning,找出计划里的盲点。
say.note: 会重点攻击弱假设和过度设计。

howto.what_en: When triggered, Claude acts as lead, spawns a 5-member adversarial team attacking each other's findings, keeps only surviving insights, then passes them to a planner for executable plan formalization.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says 'hyperplan', 'hpp', 'adversarial plan', etc., or requests planning that needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan mode to plan this feature.
say_en.note: Claude will start a 5-member adversarial team cross-review.

say_en.text: Start adversarial plan, brutally critique my proposal.
say_en.note: Members attack each other, only defensible points survive.

say_en.text: Enable hostile planning, find blind spots in the plan.
say_en.note: It targets weak assumptions and over-engineering.
